description:
You are a Corporate Counsel reviewing a 'Service Level Agreement'. The vendor has returned a modified version (contract_v2_vendor.odt) of your original draft (contract_v1_original.odt). You need to generate a redline comparison and then create a final resolved version.

1. Open '/home/ga/Documents/contract_v1_original.odt'.
2. Use 'Track Changes > Compare Document' to compare it with '/home/ga/Documents/contract_v2_vendor.odt'.
3. Save the resulting comparison document (showing all redlines) as '/home/ga/Documents/contract_comparison.odt'.
4. In this comparison document, process the changes:
   - ACCEPT the change to Payment Terms (30 days -> 45 days).
   - ACCEPT the added 'Force Majeure' clause.
   - REJECT the deletion of the 'Arbitration' clause (keep the Arbitration clause).
   - REJECT the change to 'Limitation of Liability' (keep it at $1,000,000, reject the reduction to $500,000).
5. Save the final clean version (with changes accepted/rejected) as '/home/ga/Documents/contract_final_resolved.odt'.
